params.title: Bare ref hover
params.initial_input:
mkdir -p /tmp/cmux-ref-hover/bare/.git/objects /tmp/cmux-ref-hover/bare/.git/refs/heads && cd /tmp/cmux-ref-hover/bare && printf '[core]
\trepositoryformatversion = 0
\tbare = false
[remote "origin"]
\turl = https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux.git
\tfetch = +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*
' > .git/config && printf 'ref: refs/heads/main
' > .git/HEAD && clear; for i in $(seq 60); do echo '#15221 #15221 #15221 #15221 #15221 #15221 #15221 #15221 '; done
